explanation: The image-plus-overlay approach was suitable, but reserving headline space at the top conflicted with the large face occupying that area. The overlay's broad top band consequently covered the forehead and eyes; a dedicated left-side text area would have avoided this. Requesting 16:9 in generation and overlay settings also did not replace an explicit crop to guarantee the final aspect ratio.
better_chain: image (generate a large tired face on the right, with generous edge margins and an empty left half) → crop (ensure exact 16:9 while preserving the face and text area) → text-overlay (place STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT entirely within the left half, including its backing) → check (verify three words, phone-size readability, unobstructed face, safe margins, and final aspect)

steps.issue: The subject and tool were appropriate, but the layout requested top headline space while putting a large face on the right without keeping it below that space. A separate left-side headline region would have been safer.
